questions.stem: Team X has median $45$ and IQR $12$. Team Y has median $48$ and IQR $30$. Which team is more consistent?

options.text: Team X, because it has a smaller IQR
Team Y, because it has a higher median
Team X, because it has a lower median
Team Y, because it has a larger IQR

questions.explanation: A smaller IQR indicates that the middle $50\%$ of the data is closer together, meaning Team X's results are more consistent (less spread out).

questions.stem: Why is the interquartile range (IQR) often preferred over the range when comparing distributions?

options.text: The IQR is not affected by outliers
The IQR is easier to calculate
The IQR uses all of the data values

questions.explanation: The IQR measures the spread of the middle $50\%$ of data, so it is not influenced by extreme values (outliers). The range, by contrast, can be heavily distorted by a single outlier.
